title: LeadForge Sprint Pipeline Record
description: One JSON object per line (JSONL). Each stage reads the record the previous stage wrote, copies every field through untouched, and adds only its own new fields. Never drop a field you don't use.

lead_id.description: Stage 1 (Nurul). Stable unique id, e.g. sd_0042.

domain.description: Stage 1. Bare domain, no scheme. Used for dedupe.

site_text.description: Stage 1. Trafilatura-extracted text, homepage + About/Services, capped at 4000 chars.

website_url.description: Stage 2 (Intern 5). Normalized URL that was actually fetched.

phone_visible.description: Stage 2. Visible phone number found in the page body text.

contact_form.description: Stage 2. A visible <form> containing input/textarea/select fields.

load_time_seconds.description: Stage 2. Desktop page load time, null if the page never loaded.

horizontal_scroll_mobile.description: Stage 2. True means the mobile view needs horizontal scroll, i.e. NOT mobile friendly.

desktop_screenshot.description: Stage 2. Path, screenshots/{lead_id}_desktop.png. Null on failure.

mobile_screenshot.description: Stage 2. Path, screenshots/{lead_id}_mobile.png. Null on failure.

status.description: Stage 2. Whether the desktop fetch succeeded.

error.description: Stage 2. Error message if status is 'error', else null.

findings.description: Stage 3 (Haseeb). Exactly 3 items per lead, one LLM call per lead.

claim.description: One specific, concrete observation about the business's site.

quote.description: Verbatim substring of site_text supporting the claim.

quote_verified.description: True only if `quote` is confirmed to literally appear in site_text.

score_reasons.description: Stage 4. Top signals that drove the score.

subject.description: Stage 5 (Amna). Only present for band A/B.

body.description: Stage 5. Under 120 words, references >=2 findings by specific content.

claims_referenced.description: Stage 5. Count of findings recognisably present in body.

final_body.description: Dashboard. Final text after human edit, if any.

decided_at.description: Dashboard. ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the decision.
